column7: Probably better to map this to unopened flower than breaking flower bud because observers will report this from the time the first reproductive bud breaks all the way through only unopened flowers until the first flower is open

although there could be senesced marcescent leaves present, which are technically true leaves, the intent here is to indicate no expanding or unfolded leaves, so true leaf absent is the best choice given how the PPO is structured

cannot say leaves absent because definition is "Most or all have dropped", no need to report non-senescing unfolded true leaf absent because this would already be reported under leaf color change status
